blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuano basketball star Nic Cabanero delivered the game-winning basket at the buzzer to lift Binan Tatak Gel past Rizal XentroMall, 72-70, and move a win away from the South Division finals of the Maharlika Pilipinas Basketball League (MPBL) 2026 Season on Wednesday at the Quezon Convention Center in Lucena City. Cabanero’s clutch performance added further weight to his bid for this season’s Most Valuable Player award, as the league’s MVP race pacesetter once again showed why he is among the leading contenders.
